newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA SHARES MIXED, BROKERS HOPE FOR GAINS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA SHARES MIXED, BROKERS HOPE FOR GAINS.

text.p: Lithuania's blue chip shares showed a mixed trend on Thursday after recent gains although dealers were hopeful a recent run of rises would kick in again.
The blue chip official list slid 13.99 points to 1079.45 points although the wider group-A index gained 4.91 points to 1843.41 points.
Central market turnover sunk to 528,000 litas from 1.5 million litas.
Hermis Bank brought down the official list, falling to 250 litas from 265 litas in lower central market turnover of 66,000 litas.
It was expected to recover to 260 litas in coming sessions with a pickup in activity, brokers said.
"When prices go down on bank shares, buyers appear," said one dealer.
Hermis also saw a healthy 4.9 million litas turnover in block trades at 260 litas to 266 litas.
Brokers say Vilniaus, which held steady at 300 litas, may take off again and hit 310 or 315 litas next week.
Shares in Rokishkis Cheese, currently rising after its first-half results, advanced to 47.98 litas from 47 litas, but its central market turnover was a relatively low 39,000 litas.
Brokers say Rokishkis shares could go as high as 50 litas and expect turnover to become more active.
